messages:
june: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands today — quick follow-up thread with the key links, clarifications, and owners. Please ack your items and add any missing context.

maria: Ack. can you drop the slide deck and the recording? missed the last 10 mins.

june: Slides + recording: https://redwood.app/slides/all-hands-2026-03-23 and https://redwood.app/recordings/all-hands-2026-03-23. Roadmap doc (internal): https://confluence.redwood/roadmap/Q2-2026.

june: Quick owner/ask list so things don't fall through:
- Roadmap milestones & public dates -> aj (status update by 2026-04-05)
- Dedicated GA checklist & perf targets -> samir (target publish 2026-05-03)
- Private deploy compliance package -> lia (publish checklist 2026-04-20)
- Cost optimization playbook (Redwood Optimize beta) -> maria (draft by 2026-04-12)

aj: Re: API rate-limit change question from the Q&A — we're keeping default rate limits the same for hosted tenants, but we'll introduce a new per-route throttle config for high-throughput customers. Action: update SDKs and examples. I'll open a tracking doc and PRs this week.

aj: Quick snippet for the new batching config we'll include in the SDKs:
```
batching: {
  max_tokens_per_batch: 4096,
  preferred_latency_ms: 80
}
```

samir: Dedicated GA clarifying note: target May 3rd for beta GA to partners. Perf SLOs we're aiming for: p95 < 120ms for 1-2k rps on the 8xA100 pool. SRE, can you run the perf harness against the staging pool next week and post results? I'll publish the benchmark doc under the repo by 2026-04-10.

lia: For Private (VPC/on-prem) compliance package: I'm assembling the checklist (KMS/HSM patterns, audit log hooks, network diagrams). Need security review — @maria can you coordinate with Security to get the first pass review by 2026-04-18?

maria: Yes, I'll coordinate. Also for the Optimize playbook, can we include quantization recommendations per-model-family? I'll start with Llama and Mistral variants.

aj: That works — I'll add a short section in the docs for quantization profiles and expected latency/cost tradeoffs.

ops-bot: Created follow-up checklist: https://tasks.redwood/board/all-hands-followups-1938821123 (items auto-assigned as per thread).

june: Couple of clarifications from the Q&A that came up: 1) No pricing changes at launch of Dedicated GA — pricing will be announced separately after GA is stable. 2) Customers on Dedicated can opt into model pinning or auto-minor-updates. 3) We'll run a public benchmark week after GA — devx will post signup.

maria: One more ask from support: can we publish a short troubleshooting guide for common integration errors (401s, model not found, token quotas)? I'll prototype a gist and share for review.

aj: I'll update the SDK changelog and add a migration guide for any rate-limit route configs.

samir: SRE note: I'll schedule the perf runs Tue/Wed and post raw logs to the perf repo. If any team wants access to the harness, ping me.

june: Thanks — please update this thread as you make progress and mark items done in the checklist. If anything needs leadership decisions, tag me. :thumbsup:

maria: acked and added initial doc links to the checklist.

aj: ack, will post SDK PRs by EOD Fri.

samir: ack, perf runs scheduled.

lia: ack, security review requested.
